prompt.v: Which study could show whether fertilizer affects plant height?

problems.text: design for cause (fertilizer): options a=experiment, b=records, c=survey

options.label: Randomly assign different amounts of fertilizer, then measure plant height.
Look up past records of fertilizer and plant height, and compare them.
Survey people about their fertilizer and plant height, and find the correlation.

problems.explain: Only random assignment makes the groups alike in everything except fertilizer, so a difference in plant height can be put down to it.
